paras: The Angolan girdled lizard (Cordylus angolensis), also known as the Angolan spiny-tailed lizard, is a species of lizard in the genus Cordylus. The species is endemic to Angola, as its names testify, and is ovoviviparous.
C. angolensis is ovoviviparous, meaning females keep eggs inside their bodies until ready to hatch.
